Esquemas (sin los del sistema).sql: select count(*) from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg\_%' and nspname <> 'information_schema'

Tablas base en `public`.sql: select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r'

Vistas en `public`.sql: select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'v'

Tablas base en `app` (internas).sql: select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'app' and c.relkind = 'r'

Columnas de las tablas de `public`.sql:
select count(*) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped

Columnas NOT NULL.sql:
select count(*) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and a.attnotnull

Columnas GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY.sql:
select count(*) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and a.attidentity = 'a'

Columnas binarias o de arreglo (RNF-03).sql:
select count(*) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and exists (select 1 from pg_type t where t.oid = a.atttypid and (t.typname = 'bytea' or t.typcategory = 'A'))

Llaves primarias.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'p'

Llaves foráneas.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'f'

de ellas ON DELETE RESTRICT.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'f' and c.confdeltype = 'r'

de ellas ON DELETE CASCADE.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'f' and c.confdeltype = 'c'

Restricciones UNIQUE.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'u'

Restricciones CHECK.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.contype = 'c'

Índices en `public` (todos).sql: select count(*) from pg_index i join pg_class t on t.oid = i.indrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public'

únicos parciales (sin restricción).sql: select count(*) from pg_index i join pg_class t on t.oid = i.indrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and i.indisunique and i.indpred is not null

de apoyo no únicos (ix_*).sql: select count(*) from pg_index i join pg_class t on t.oid = i.indrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and not i.indisunique

Tipos ENUM.sql: select count(distinct t.oid) from pg_type t join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.typnamespace join pg_enum e on e.enumtypid = t.oid where n.nspname = 'public'

Valores en total de los ENUM.sql: select count(*) from pg_enum e join pg_type t on t.oid = e.enumtypid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.typnamespace where n.nspname = 'public'

Funciones en `public` (RPC).sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public'

prefijo api_ (las llama la interfaz).sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'api\_%'

prefijo svc_ (solo service_role).sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'svc\_%'

SECURITY DEFINER.sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.prosecdef

SECURITY INVOKER.sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and not p.prosecdef

Funciones en `app` (lógica interna).sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'app'

de ellas funciones de disparador (trg_.sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'app' and p.prorettype = 'trigger'::regtype

Disparadores (no internos) en `public`.sql: select count(*) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal and n.nspname = 'public'

Tablas con RLS habilitado en `public`.sql: select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and c.relrowsecurity

Políticas RLS en `public`.sql: select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public'

Políticas en `storage` (RESTRICTIVE).sql: select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage'

Privilegios de `anon` sobre tablas de `p.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema = 'public' and grantee = 'anon'

Privilegios de `authenticated` distintos.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema = 'public' and grantee = 'authenticated' and privilege_type <> 'SELECT'
